summary: The reader is an undergraduate computer scientist: comfortable with asymptotic analysis, basic algorithm design (divide and conquer, recurrences, the idea of FFT-style multiplication at the level of knowing it exists), discrete math (modular arithmetic, primes, gcd, binary representation), and linear algebra (vectors, matrices, subspaces, rank, dimension, invertibility). They know complex numbers and polynomials, and basic multitape Turing machines. They have not studied the specialist material of the paper: Harvey-van der Hoeven machinery, Gaussian resampling, Bluestein, Chinese-remainder multidimensional reindexing, Bruhat factorization, or precise fixed-point error analysis.

known.name: Linear algebra over a field
known.gloss: Vectors, matrices, subspaces, their dimension and rank, and invertible linear maps.

known.name: Modular arithmetic
known.gloss: Arithmetic on integers with remainders modulo m, including addition and multiplication of residues.

known.name: Primes, gcd and coprimality
known.gloss: Basic number theory facts about primes, greatest common divisors and coprime integers.

known.name: Binary representation and bit operations
known.gloss: Integers as binary strings with value given by powers of two, and bitwise XOR of bit strings.

known.name: Logarithms, floor and ceiling
known.gloss: Standard logarithm and rounding functions used in running-time expressions.

known.name: Permutations
known.gloss: Bijective rearrangements of a finite index set and their composition and inversion.

known.name: Mixed-radix and positional digit expansion
known.gloss: Writing an integer index as a tuple of digits in given radices, ordered lexicographically.

known.name: Multidimensional arrays and tensors
known.gloss: Arrays indexed by several coordinates, with a transform applied along each axis separately.

known.name: Elementary Gaussian integers and dyadic rationals
known.gloss: Numbers of the form m/2^k, and complex numbers whose parts are such numbers.

known.name: Norms, error bounds and rounding
known.gloss: Bounding magnitudes via norms and the triangle inequality, and rounding to the nearest integer when error is below 1/2.

known.name: Schoolbook carry addition
known.gloss: Adding integers digit by digit with carries in linear time and multiplying in quadratic time.

known.name: Geometric series and recurrences
known.gloss: Solving simple cost recurrences and summing geometric series to bound recursive running time.

known.name: Roots of unity and Euler's formula
known.gloss: The complex n-th roots of unity and the exponential form of points on the unit circle.

known.name: Basic finite-set combinatorics
known.gloss: Counting subsets and their intersections in a finite set.

known.name: Deterministic algorithms and tape scans
known.gloss: Deterministic procedures on tapes that sweep data in linear time, such as copying and merging.
